criteria.requirement: Implement cattrs.strategies.pathlike.configure_pathlike(converter, *, factory=Path) for PathLike and PathLike[str] annotations through actual predicate hooks. Unstructure using os.fspath and require str output, structure only str through an explicit factory returning text PathLike, reject byte paths/invalid factory returns without implicit decoding. Support nested JSON records and custom __fspath__, never touch the filesystem, and preserve concrete Path defaults and converter isolation.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
